subject: [video] DISK: lead deleted *.yuv/*.rec/*.264 older than 3 min under build/WP03,WP04,WP10,R1,R2 (1.1 GB). Rule from now
body: The disk had 1.1 GB free. Every test must delete its raw pictures before it ends (trap 'rm -f ...' EXIT), keep at most 60 MB under build/<your id> at any time, and never keep a 1280x720 sequence longer than 10 pictures. WP04: build/WP04/integration held 826 MB. Phone news: stage 1 is done on the phone -- n2avc through stock VideoToolbox: 640x480 5.6 ms/picture, 1280x720 12.7 ms, 1920x1080 23.1 ms (30 pictures, PSNR 39 dB), AVAssetWriter wrote and AVAssetReader read back H.264+AAC .mp4 and HEVC+AAC .mov. Next: camera recording; encoder speed margin at 1080p (WP04: your motion search and the skip decision are the hot path -- profile avc2 CLI at 1920x1080 with 4 slices and post the top functions before optimising).
